slot_scores.name: single_vehicle_per_customer
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never explicitly asked whether a customer's demand can be split across multiple vehicles or must be served by exactly one vehicle. The catch-all question about additional constraints at turn 7 does not clearly target this issue.

slot_scores.name: depot_return_requirement
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Do all trucks start at the central depot at time 0 and must they return to the central depot after completing their route?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether trucks must return to the depot after completing their route, directly covering the hidden depot-return requirement.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Each customer must be visited exactly once, implying split deliveries are not allowed.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent did not ask whether customer demand could be split across vehicles, but later listed 'Each customer must be visited exactly once' under confirmed understanding without confirmation.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL with the P1 slot H1 unresolved: it never confirmed whether each customer must be served by exactly one vehicle rather than allowing split deliveries.

summary: The agent correctly clarified depot return, objective, capacity, time windows, service time, and travel time, but missed the single-vehicle-per-customer hidden requirement and silently assumed it in the final understanding. It stopped prematurely with an unresolved P1 slot.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
